Baggage Allowance

Link to Baggage Allowance website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-allowance/

Free Checked Baggage Allowance:

Baggage allowance details shown are indications for Kenya Airways-operated flights only and may be subject to change depending on the aircraft operated on the day of travel. Flights operated by other airlines under a Kenya Airways flight number may be subject to other baggage restrictions.

Kiwango cha Mizigo Kinachoruhusiwa

Kiungo cha ukurasa wa tovuti kuhusu kiwango cha mizigo kinachoruhusiwa: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-allowance/

Kiwango cha Mizigo Inayosajiliwa Kinachoruhusiwa Bila Malipo:

Maelezo yaliyoonyeshwa kuhusu kiwango cha mizigo kinachoruhusiwa ni mwongozo kwa safari za ndege zinazoendeshwa na Kenya Airways pekee na yanaweza kubadilika kulingana na ndege inayotumika siku ya safari. Safari zinazoendeshwa na mashirika mengine ya ndege chini ya nambari ya safari ya Kenya Airways zinaweza kuwa na vikwazo vingine vya mizigo.

parents.english_text:
[List level 1] - As a mandatory standard each piece of checked in baggage shall have a name label that bears the passenger's name, physical address, and phone number on the outside and also on the inside. The name should be the same as the one mentioned on the ticket. An email address is also recommended.

Exceptions

[List level 1] - Guests travelling from Jeddah are allowed to carry one free bottle of Holy Water, Max 5 Litres. The bottle must be sealed with a plastic covering to avoid leakage. KQ has no liability on Holy Water, no claims shall be filed. Note: For ease of handling, the maximum weight of each piece of baggage shall not exceed 23kgs (50Ibs) and total dimensions shall not exceed 158cms (62 inches) (L+W+H)

[List level 1] - Under special conditions or authorization, non-normal item, motorized wheelchairs, special sporting equipment may be accepted as checked baggage with exceeding weight of 23kgs.

[List level 1] - In addition to free cabin baggage allowance, an infant is entitled to 1 collapsible stroller plus 1 car seat free of charge.

[List level 1] - Incapacitated passengers may carry one wheelchair or mobility device free of charge.

[List level 1] - The actual free allowance of the guest may differ if code share or interline traffic is involved. In these cases, the allowance is automatically calculated in compliance with IATA Resolution 302.

[List level 1] - Free baggage allowance applied will be as stated in the Departure Control System (DCS) or on the e-ticket.

Interline and Codeshare Allowance and Sharing Policy

Interline and Codeshare Allowance and Sharing Policy

IATA Resolution 302 determines the Most Significant Carrier (MSC) whose baggage allowance is applied when the journey involves Interline partners. Journeys that involve interline partners/codeshare partners apply different baggage allowances:

[List level 1] - The free baggage allowance shown on the ticket, the trip summary or in the check in system for interline or code share flights is granted.

[List level 1] - For flights originating or terminating to the US/CANADA, piece concept applies based on the specified weight.

[List level 1] - Excess baggage charges are applied through to the final destination.

Pooling of Allowance

[List level 1] - Pooling of excess bags is allowed for families or a group or party travelling to a common destination e.g. sportsmen, affinity groups etc.

[List level 1] - The families or group or party shall be travelling together and check-in their baggage to the same destination on the same flight(s) at the same time.

[List level 1] - Each individual passenger shall always be given their own individual baggage” claim” tag.

[List level 1] - For security reasons only families are allowed to register their checked baggage in one check-in record.

[List level 1] - Kwa safari zinazoanzia au kumalizikia MAREKANI/KANADA, mfumo wa kuhesabu idadi ya vipande vya mizigo hutumika kwa kuzingatia uzito ulioainishwa.

[List level 1] - Ada za mizigo ya ziada hutozwa hadi mahali pa mwisho pa safari.

[List level 1] - Familia au kundi la watu lazima lisafiri pamoja na kusajili mizigo yao kuelekea mahali pamoja kwa safari ileile (au safari zilezile) za ndege kwa wakati mmoja.

[List level 1] - Kila abiria lazima apewe lebo yake binafsi ya kudai mizigo.

[List level 1] - Kwa sababu za usalama, ni familia pekee zinazoruhusiwa kusajili mizigo yao katika rekodi moja ya usajili.

Baggage Allowance for an Extra seat purchased

Acceptance Conditions

[List level 1] - Extra seat(s) shall be requested and paid for in advance. Approval is needed from Revenue Management.

[List level 1] - The normal applicable free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

[List level 1] - The items carried on the extra seat shall not restrict access to or use of any required emergency or regular exit, or aisle(s) in the cabin.

Note:

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased to transport baggage in cabin, CCBG, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

When an extra seat is purchased for corpulent passenger, the extra seat does not benefit of a free baggage allowance.

Accompanied Company Material (COML)

[List level 1] - All movement of accompanied company materials to/from outstations shall be approved and consented by controlling manager.

[List level 1] - All requests for authorizing excess COML as accompanied baggage shall be forwarded to the controlling Manager.

[List level 1] - The station teams shall ask for copies of consent.

[List level 1] - The approval shall be appended on the booking of the staff accompanying the company materials.

Special Baggage

Link to Special Baggage Website: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/special-baggage/

General

[List level 1] - Special baggage is all baggage that, because of its nature, size, or weight, may be accepted only under certain conditions.

[List level 1] - For acceptance of special baggage the conditions of carriage applies.

[List level 1] - For some types of special baggage advance reservations should be made or Kenya Airways may refuse acceptance if deemed necessary.

Medicines:

Kenya Airways has no restrictions on the carriage of medicines except when the medicine is classified as Dangerous Goods such as:

[List level 1] - An inflammable liquid

[List level 1] - Toxic, infectious or radioactive material

[List level 1] - A gas

Helium Balloons:

Although Helium is not considered as Dangerous Goods, the transportation of balloons filled up with Helium is forbidden because they can explode onboard.

Lithium Batteries:

Lithium batteries can generate a great amount of heat if short circuited, or may catch fire if damaged, improperly designed or improperly assembled. Spare batteries must be individually protected to prevent short circuits by placement in the original retail packaging or by otherwise insulating terminals, e.g. by taping over exposed terminals or placing each battery in a separate plastic bag or protective pouch and carried in carry-on baggage only.

[List level 1] - Bicycles and Tandems:
Bicycles and Tandems should be considered as part of the normal baggage allowance unless guest is in excess and extra weight charges will apply.
To pack a bike the following shall be done:

[List level 2] - Handlebar turned lengthwise.

[List level 2] - Pedals shall be removed or folded back.

[List level 2] - Lowering the air pressure of the tyre is recommended to reduce the risk of a flat tyre caused by the pressure difference in the air.

[List level 2] - Advance reservation is required for KQ.

[List level 2] - Bicycles and tandems must be suitably packed in a carton bike box or a hard cover provided by the passenger.

[List level 2] - If the bicycle or tandem is packed in other material than a box or a hard cover (e.g. plastic cover) it must be tagged with a limited release tag. Mark on the limited release tag "unsuitably packed".

[List level 2] - At the passengers own risk, KQ will accept a bike/Tandem that is not suitably packed in a box or hard cover. As verification the passenger shall be advised about this at check-in and the customer service staff must mark on the limited release portion of the baggage tag “UNSUITABLY PACKED”.

NOTE: On E170/190 a maximum of 03 bicycles or tandems are accepted.
Electric Bicycles are not accepted.

[List level 2] - Kuweka nafasi mapema kunahitajika kwa KQ.

[List level 2] - Baiskeli na baiskeli za watu wawili lazima zipakiwe ipasavyo kwenye sanduku la kadibodi la baiskeli au kifuniko kigumu kinachotolewa na abiria.

[List level 2] - Ikiwa baiskeli au baiskeli ya watu wawili imepakiwa katika kitu kingine badala ya sanduku au kifuniko kigumu (mfano kifuniko cha plastiki), lazima iwekwe lebo inayoonyesha uwajibikaji wenye mipaka. Andika kwenye lebo hiyo “unsuitably packed” (haijapakiwa ipasavyo).

[List level 2] - Kwa hatari ya abiria mwenyewe, KQ itakubali baiskeli au baiskeli ya watu wawili ambayo haijapakiwa ipasavyo kwenye sanduku au kifuniko kigumu. Kwa uthibitisho, abiria ataarifiwa kuhusu hali hiyo wakati wa usajili na wafanyakazi wa huduma kwa wateja lazima waandike “UNSUITABLY PACKED” kwenye sehemu ya lebo ya mizigo inayoonyesha uwajibikaji wenye mipaka.

KUMBUKA: Katika E170/190, baiskeli au baiskeli za watu wawili zisizozidi 03 ndizo zinazokubaliwa.
Baiskeli za umeme hazikubaliwi.

[List level 1] - Diving Equipment:
The diving equipment may consist of: Wet suit, vest, socks, mask, shoes, webs, knives and regulator. It is considered as a standard piece of baggage. Where allowance is exceeded, apply the special excess baggage charge for one (01) dive equipment up to 20kgs for one way travel.

NOTE: Scuba tank (an empty air cylinder) is not considered part of diving equipment. However it can be accepted as baggage at a charge.

Conditions:

[List level 2] - Accept diving equipment on operating flights under following conditions: Diving equipment and air cylinders shall be identified with the “SPEQ DIVING” remark. Batteries must be carried in the cabin baggage or hold baggage and need clearance from the passenger handling teams based on PHM 4.0 or DGR 2.3.A.

[List level 2] - Oxygen cylinders must be empty. Lamp and batteries must be disconnected from the torch.

Baggage Conditions Rules

Baggage Conditions link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/conditions-of-carriage-baggage/

Article 8 Baggage

8.1 Free Baggage Allowance

You may carry some Baggage, free of charge, subject to our conditions and limitations, which are available on our website Baggage information (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/ )

8.2 Excess Baggage

You will be required to pay a charge for carriage of Baggage in excess of the free Baggage allowance. To learn more about  the rates kindly reach out to us on +254711024747.

8.3 Items Unacceptable as Baggage

8.3.1 You must not include in your Baggage:

8.3.1.2 Items the carriage of which is prohibited by the applicable laws, regulations or orders of any state to be flown from or to;

8.3.1.3 Items which are reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because they are dangerous or unsafe, or because of their weight, size, shape or character, or because they are fragile or perishable having regard to, among other things, the type of aircraft being used. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.3.2 Firearms and ammunition other than for hunting and sporting purposes are prohibited from carriage as Baggage. Firearms and ammunition for hunting and sporting purposes may be accepted as Checked Baggage. Firearms must be unloaded, with the safety catch on, and suitably packed. Carriage of ammunition is subject to ICAO and IATA regulations as specified in Article 8.3.1.1.

8.3.6 Air Carriage of Electronic Devices containing Lithium Batteries being Recalled.

On June 20, 2019 a notice for recall was issued for a limited number of older generation 15-inch MacBook Pro units supplied by Apple Inc. between September 2015 and February 2017. Following the recall notice, The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) recommends that operators inform crews, passengers and staff about any restrictions and limitations on carrying such devices on board. If such a device is taken on board, the passenger is required to keep it switched off and not use or charge the device. Passengers should also be reminded to inform cabin crew immediately when a device is damaged, hot, produces smoke, is lost or falls into the seat structure. For more information, on the EASA bulletin kindly visit https://www.easa.europa.eu/newsroom-and-events/news/safety-precautions-regarding-transport-air-recalled-portable-electronic . Additionally for more information on the Apple Inc. 15 inch MacBook Pro Battery Recall kindly visit https://support.apple.com/15-inch-macbook-pro-battery-recall

You may be required to pay a separate charge for this service.

8.8 Collection and Delivery of Checked Baggage

8.8.1 Subject to Article 8.6.3, you are required to collect your Checked Baggage as soon as it is made available at your destination or Stopover. Should you not collect it within a reasonable time, we may charge you a storage fee. Should your Checked Baggage not be claimed within three (3) months of the time it is made available, we may dispose of it without any liability to you.

8.8.2 Only the bearer of the Baggage Check and Baggage Identification Tag is entitled to delivery of the Checked Baggage.

8.8.3 If a person claiming Checked Baggage is unable to produce the Baggage Check and identify the Baggage by means of a Baggage Identification Tag, we will deliver the Baggage to such person only on condition that he or she establishes to our satisfaction his or her right to the Baggage.

Ikiwa Mizigo yako Inayosajiliwa haitadaiwa ndani ya miezi mitatu (3) tangu ilipopatikana, tunaweza kuiondoa bila kuwajibika kwako kwa namna yoyote.

8.8.2 Ni mwenye Hati ya Mizigo na Lebo ya Utambulisho wa Mizigo pekee anayestahili kukabidhiwa Mizigo Inayosajiliwa.

8.8.3 Ikiwa mtu anayedai Mizigo Inayosajiliwa hawezi kuwasilisha Hati ya Mizigo na kuitambua Mizigo kwa kutumia Lebo ya Utambulisho wa Mizigo, tutamkabidhi Mizigo hiyo tu ikiwa atathibitisha kwa kiwango kinachoturidhisha kuwa ana haki ya Mizigo hiyo.

8.9 Animals

We reserve the right, at our absolute discretion, to refuse to carry any animals. If we agree to carry any animals they will be carried subject to the following conditions:

8.9.1 You must ensure that animals such as dogs, cats, household birds and other pets, are properly crated (or carried in a container complying with any applicable legal requirements) and accompanied by valid health and vaccination certificates, entry permits, and other documents required by countries of entry or transit, failing which they will not be accepted for carriage. Such carriage may be subject to additional conditions specified by us, which are available on request.

8.9.2 If accepted as Baggage, the animal, together with its container and food, shall not be included in your free Baggage allowance, but shall constitute excess baggage, for which you will be obliged to pay the applicable rate.

8.9.3 Guide dogs accompanying Passengers with disabilities will be carried free of charge in addition to the normal free baggage allowance, subject to conditions specified by us, which are available on request.

8.9.4 Where carriage is not subject to the liability rules of the Convention, we are not responsible for injury to or loss, sickness or death of an animal which we have agreed to carry unless we have been negligent.

8.9.1 Lazima uhakikishe kuwa wanyama kama vile mbwa, paka, ndege wanaofugwa nyumbani na wanyama wengine wa kufugwa wamewekwa ipasavyo kwenye vizimba (au wanasafirishwa katika chombo kinachotimiza matakwa yoyote ya sheria yanayotumika) na wanaambatana na vyeti halali vya afya na chanjo, vibali vya kuingia nchi na hati nyingine zinazohitajika na nchi wanazoingia au kupita; vinginevyo hawatakubaliwa kusafirishwa. 8.9.3 Mbwa wa kuongoza wanaoandamana na Abiria wenye ulemavu watasafirishwa bila malipo, zaidi ya kiwango cha kawaida cha mizigo kinachoruhusiwa bila malipo, kwa kuzingatia masharti tuliyoweka yanayopatikana ukiomba.

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Security-type cases/boxes incorporating goods such as lithium batteries or pyrotechnics

[List level 1] - Compressed gases (flammable, non-flammable, or poisonous) such as butane, propane, aqualung cylinders, lighter fuels, or refills

[List level 1] - Oxidizing substances such as bleaching powder and peroxides

[List level 1] - Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives

[List level 1] - Disabling devices such as mace or pepper sprays, with irritant properties

[List level 1] - Poisons such as arsenic, cyanides, or insecticides

[List level 1] - Radioactive materials

[List level 1] - Corrosive materials such as mercury (which may be contained in thermometers or blood pressure gauges,) acids, alkalis, and wet cell batteries

Baggage Security Guidelines

Baggage Security Guidelines Web page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-security-guidelines/

Security Removed Items

These are items taken at a security check from a guest or from his/her hand baggage because they are not allowed to be carried at all as these items are classified as weapons or Dangerous Goods.

Some items can only be accepted as checked baggage (sharp, pointed, blunt objects, tools or any toys imitating one of these items).

This information is available at any check-in touch point; therefore once a guest declares, request the guest to include the item in his check-in baggage.

At security control any forbidden object detected is confiscated from the guest and disposed off.

my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

5.2 VIKOMO VYA MUDA WA KUTOLEWA KWA TIKETI

Ikiwa hujalipia Tiketi kabla ya kikomo cha muda wa kutolewa kwa tiketi kilichoainishwa, kama tulivyokuarifu sisi au Wakala wetu Aliyeidhinishwa, tunaweza kufuta nafasi yako ya safari. Pia tunahifadhi haki ya kufuta au kukataa usafirishaji ikiwa kuna kiasi chochote cha fedha ambacho bado unatudaiwa kulipa kutokana na miamala ya awali, au ikiwa malipo yatabatilishwa, yatapingwa au hayatakubaliwa baadaye.

5.3 DATA BINAFSI

Ukusanyaji, matumizi na ushirikishaji wa data binafsi kuhusiana na nafasi yako ya safari na safari yako unatawaliwa na Sera yetu ya Faragha, ambayo ni sehemu ya Masharti haya ya Usafirishaji na inapatikana kwenye tovuti yetu.

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways' liability could be reduced if baggage was presented for check-in unsuitably packed or after the recommended check-in time.

[List level 1] - Should you need to make a claim for compensation, this will be required in writing within seven days after your arrival to your nearest Kenya Airways airport office or you should contact your insurance company.

FAQS

FAQs link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/help/faqs/

Booking & Payment FAQs

What are my payment options?

Pay quickly and efficiently through any of our payment options: credit and debit cards, eWallet , mobile payment or real-time bank transfer. Read more about our payments options.(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/booking-online/payment-methods/ )

Can I make an online payment in a currency of my choice?

Our prices are automatically displayed based on the country you are booking from.

For example, if you are in the United Kingdom, booking a flight from Nairobi to London, the price displayed, and the price you need to pay, will be in British Pound.

Please note that if you’re paying with a different currency from your card, your financial institution may apply different exchange rates to the fare displayed on the booking page. There may be additional charges incurred, so please check with your financial institution before making your booking.

Can I make changes to my flight details?

Manage My Booking allows you to modify an existing flight booking:

[List level 1] - Change travel dates

[List level 1] - Upgrade to business class

[List level 1] - Request special meals

[List level 1] - Select preferred seats

[List level 1] - Purchase extra legroom

[List level 1] - Update contact information

[List level 1] - Pay in advance for excess baggage

[List level 1] - Request for refund

Bei zetu huonyeshwa kiotomatiki kulingana na nchi unakoweka nafasi ukiwa huko.

Tozo za ziada zinaweza kutokea, hivyo tafadhali wasiliana na taasisi yako ya kifedha kabla ya kuweka nafasi.

Bookings purchased directly from Kenya-airways.com, Kenya Airways direct offices and preferred travel agents can be modified online through Manage My Booking.

Contact our Global Contact Centers or local offices to correct a name in a booking. Rules and fees apply.

The extra Legroom Seats are located in Economy Class exit rows with a generous space for you to stretch out. It is offered only on Kenya Airways-operated flights and is not available on flights operated by our partner airlines.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements. Please view all requirements before making your purchase to ensure you meet all of the criteria.

Who can book an Extra Legroom Seat?

Guest must:

[List level 1] - Be physically able to reach, locate and operate the emergency exit window or door, and to quickly pass through the exit.

[List level 1] - Be able to understand and acknowledge instructions in English.

[List level 1] - Be aged 18 years or older and not have any conditions.

[List level 1] - Not be travelling with children or infants, a care giver, a guide dog or an assistance animal.

[List level 1] - Not be in any stage of pregnancy

Nitumie sarafu gani kulipa kwenye Kenya-airways.com?

Nafasi za safari zilizowekwa kwenye Kenya-airways.com zinapaswa kulipiwa kwa sarafu ambayo bei ya tiketi imekokotolewa katika eneo husika. Ukiweka nafasi kwenye Kenya-airways.com, bei ya tiketi yako itaonyeshwa katika mchakato mzima wa kuweka nafasi kwa sarafu utakayotumia hatimaye kulipia tiketi. Haiwezekani kulipa kwa sarafu nyingine yoyote isipokuwa ile iliyoonyeshwa kwenye Kenya-airways.com.

Ninaweza kutumia njia zipi za malipo kulipia Time to Think?

Unaweza kutumia njia yoyote ya malipo inayokubalika kwenye tovuti au programu ya simu na katika ofisi zetu zozote za tiketi, yaani kadi za mkopo, kadi za malipo ya moja kwa moja, M-Pesa, Airtel Money, PayPal, fedha taslimu n.k.

Je, ni lazima nilipie tiketi yangu mara moja?

Unapoweka nafasi ya tiketi kwenye Kenya-airways.com, masharti ya malipo yanategemea njia ya malipo uliyochagua. Tiketi yako itatolewa mara tu tutakapopokea malipo yako. Hili litafanywa kupitia mchakato wa kawaida wa urejeshaji wa fedha kutoka ofisi iliyotoa tiketi.

Ninawezaje kupata uthibitisho wa malipo?

Tiketi yako inaonyesha maelezo kuhusu nauli na kodi zilizolipwa kwa safari yako ya ndege. Ni uthibitisho wako wa malipo na itakubalika kwa upana kama risiti.

Baada ya kuweka nafasi ya safari yako kwenye Kenya-airways.com, utapokea tiketi yako kupitia barua pepe mara tu tutakapopokea malipo.

Je, ninaweza kulipia tiketi ya mtu mwingine anayesafiri kutoka nje ya nchi?

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

No, It is not possible for any changes to be made on multi-city bookings.

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

What is Upgrade to Business Class?

Kenya Airways offers you the opportunity to determine your own price for your Business Class upgrade by submitting an offer. KQ will inform you 12 hours before departure whether or not your Upgrade has been approved.

On which routes is Upgrade to Business Class being offered?

KQ offers Upgrades on all scheduled flights in all routes.

Who can make an Offer for an Upgrade?

To be able to make an offer you need a valid and issued KQ Economy Class ticket for a scheduled flight operated by KQ. You may submit your Smart Upgrade offer up to 14 hours before Departure.

Is every Economy Class passenger eligible for getting a Business Class Upgrade?

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

What happens if an Offer was cancelled by mistake?

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

Is the time of making the Offer decisive for its ranking?

No.

Upgrade Flight

Upgrade Flight link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/upgrade-flight/

Upgrade to Business Class:

You now have various options of upgrading to our award-winning business class on Kenya Airways. With an economy class ticket, upgrading to business class and enjoying award-winning amenities is easy.

Bid to Upgrade:

Holding an economy class ticket? Our Bid to Upgrade Program allows you to quote an amount you would like to pay for the upgrade to Business Class and if your bid is the highest, you will travel in style in Africa’s leading Business Class.

You can place your bid offer online up to 7–10 hours before departure, depending on your point of departure. With a little luck, your bid will be accepted.

Have you already made your booking?

Enter your details above to see if you qualify to upgrade your ticket.

Benefits of upgrading to Business Class

[List level 1] - Fly in Africa’s leading Business Class airline.

[List level 1] - Speed through Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, Nairobi on the Sky Priority Lane through check-in, security and boarding.

[List level 1] - A business class seat is guaranteed, with complimentary lounge access available at stations that offer lounge facilities, but there is no business class baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - Enjoy the nouvelle cuisine onboard with a wide array of fine wines.

[List level 1] - More than 100 movies, documentaries, and radio shows on a 15 inch screen for your in-flight entertainment.

[List level 1] - A wide selection of newspapers and international magazines.

Kuboresha hadi Daraja la Biashara:

Sasa una njia mbalimbali za kuboresha daraja la safari yako hadi daraja letu la biashara lililoshinda tuzo katika Kenya Airways. Ukiwa na tiketi ya daraja la kawaida, ni rahisi kuboresha hadi daraja la biashara na kufurahia huduma na vifaa vilivyoshinda tuzo.

Kutoa Ofa ya Kuboresha Daraja:

Je, una tiketi ya daraja la kawaida? Mpango wetu wa Bid to Upgrade unakuwezesha kutaja kiasi ambacho ungependa kulipa ili kuboresha hadi daraja la biashara. Ikiwa ofa yako ndiyo ya juu zaidi, utasafiri kwa starehe katika daraja la biashara linaloongoza Afrika.

Unaweza kuwasilisha ofa yako kupitia mtandao hadi saa 7–10 hours kabla ya kuondoka, kutegemea mahali unakoanzia safari. Ukiwa na bahati kidogo, ofa yako itakubaliwa.

Weka maelezo yako hapo juu ili kuona kama unastahili kuboresha daraja la tiketi yako.

[List level 1] - Safiri kwa shirika la ndege linaloongoza Afrika kwa daraja la biashara.

[List level 1] - Kiti cha daraja la biashara kinahakikishwa, pamoja na ruhusa ya kutumia sebule ya abiria bila malipo katika vituo vyenye huduma za sebule, lakini hakuna kiwango cha mizigo kinachoruhusiwa cha daraja la biashara.

Upgrade to Business Class Terms and Conditions:

The following terms and conditions ("Terms and Conditions") shall apply to a bid (“Offer”) made by you (“Guest, you”) to KENYA AIRWAYS LTD (“Airline”) for an opportunity to upgrade an economy class ticket that you originally purchased for travel with the Airline to business class (“Upgrade”).

1. Offers can only be made on selected flights operated by the Airline and on condition that you already have a valid economy ticket issued by or on behalf of the Airline.

2. For you to submit an Offer, you must have reached the legal age of majority in your country of residence at the time the Offer is submitted. You shall be deemed to have the authority to act on behalf of and to bind the person or persons named or included on the Offer to these Terms and Conditions.

3. An Offer, made either directly to the Airline or indirectly through third parties and presented to the Airline shall entitle the person (s) named on the Offer, subject to these Terms and Conditions, to be considered for an Upgrade.

4. You shall be entitled to submit only one Offer per flight which corresponds to your Economy Ticket. To make an Offer you shall be required to provide valid Credit Card details. The Credit Card shall be used to make payment for the Offer upon Acceptance.

Unaweza kustahili kurejeshewa fedha za tiketi za Kenya Airways ambazo hazijatumika kabisa au ambazo sehemu yake haijatumika, kulingana na aina ya tiketi uliyonunua:

Kodi, Ada na Tozo:

[List level 1] - Kodi, ada na tozo zinazotumika zilizowekwa na serikali au mamlaka nyingine, au mwendeshaji wa uwanja wa ndege, zitalipwa nawe. Wakati wa kununua Tiketi yako, utaarifiwa kuhusu kodi, ada na tozo zisizojumuishwa katika nauli, ambazo nyingi kwa kawaida huonyeshwa kando kwenye Tiketi.

Kodi, ada na tozo zinazowekwa kwa usafiri wa anga hubadilika mara kwa mara na zinaweza kuwekwa baada ya tarehe ya kutolewa kwa Tiketi. Ikiwa kodi, ada au tozo iliyoonyeshwa kwenye Tiketi itaongezeka, utalazimika kuilipa. Vivyo hivyo, ikiwa kodi, ada au tozo mpya itawekwa hata baada ya Tiketi kutolewa, utalazimika kuilipa. Vilevile, iwapo kodi, ada au tozo zozote ulizotulipa wakati wa kutolewa kwa Tiketi zitafutwa au kupunguzwa kiasi kwamba hazitumiki tena kwako, au kiasi kidogo ndicho kinachodaiwa, utastahili kuomba urejeshaji wa fedha.

Zaidi ya hayo, ikiwa Abiria hatasafiri kwa ndege na ana tiketi inayorejeshewa fedha au isiyorejeshewa fedha, atastahili pia kurejeshewa kodi, tozo na ada nyingine husika zilizotajwa.

[List level 1] - If you cancelled your Kenya Airways flight because it was delayed for more than 8 hours complete the form here (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/request-for-your-refund/ ).

Please note once you’ve submitted this form, your entire booking will be cancelled.

NOTE: This only applies for tickets purchased on kenya-airways.com (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ )

Refund Due to Death of a Passenger or Due to Medical Reasons:

In case of the death of a passenger or cancellation due to medical reasons complete the form here (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/manage-booking/request-for-your-refund/ ).

Please note:

1. We only offer full refund for the deceased passenger only.

2. In case of medical, NO REFUND nor FREE CHANGE - need to follow the fare rules in case of refund request.

3. NO REFUND for family members who were going to accompany the deceased prior to the travel or were with him when the passenger died - date change fee will be waived.

I have a Non-Refundable Ticket and Will Not be Traveling. Can I Obtain a Refund?:

[List level 1] - You have one year from the ticket's original issue date to reschedule your travel without losing the full value of the ticket (less any applicable change fees).

parents.english_text:
Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.
parents.kiswahili_search_text:
Usafirishaji wa Wanyama Vipenzi

Kiungo cha tovuti kuhusu usafirishaji wa wanyama vipenzi: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Wanyama hai hawatakubaliwa kusafirishwa kama mizigo inayokabidhiwa kwenye sehemu ya mizigo (AVIH) au kama wanyama vipenzi ndani ya kabini (PETC) katika safari za ndege za Kenya Airways.

Wanyama hai watasafirishwa kama shehena pekee.

Isipokuwa

Mbwa wa Usaidizi

Mbwa wa usaidizi atakubaliwa ndani ya kabini ikiwa anamsaidia mtu mwenye ulemavu, yaani abiria asiyeona au mtu mwenye tatizo la kiakili au la afya ya akili. Mbwa huyo ana cheti na amefunzwa mahususi kumsaidia mtu mwenye ulemavu.

Kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu nyaraka za afya na za kuingiza mbwa wa usaidizi nchini, wasiliana na KQ Cargo ili upate mwongozo.

Kumbuka: Mbwa wote wa usaidizi lazima wawe wamefunzwa ili wakubaliwe. Mbwa wa msaada wa kihisia hawatambuliwi tena kama wanyama wa usaidizi.

Abiria wenye ulemavu wa kimwili, wa hisi, wa afya ya akili, wa kiakili au ulemavu mwingine wa akili wanaohitaji kusafiri na mbwa wa usaidizi wanaweza kuhitajika kuwasilisha nyaraka fulani kutoka kwa mtaalamu wa afya aliyeidhinishwa ambaye anamtibu abiria huyo. Nyaraka hizo ziwe za ndani ya mwaka mmoja na zieleze kuwa mbwa wa usaidizi ni muhimu kwa afya ya akili au matibabu ya abiria wakati wa safari ya ndege na/au shughuli yoyote katika eneo analoenda.

Mbwa wa Usaidizi:

[List level 1] - Wanakubaliwa bila malipo.

[List level 1] - Wanaweza kukubaliwa ndani ya kabini bila banda au kizimba, mradi wamefungwa vizuri kwa mkanda wa mwili (harness) na hawatumii kiti.

Transportation of Dogs to USA

From July 14 through October 14, 2021, dogs coming from high risk countries (link: https://www.cdc.gov/importation/dogs/high-risk-countries.html ) with CDC Dog Import Permits can enter the United States at one of these 18 airports: Anchorage, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago (ORD), Dallas (DFW), Detroit, Honolulu, Houston (IAH), Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, New York (JFK), Newark, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Juan, Seattle, and Washington, DC (Dulles).

All dogs imported into the United States must be healthy on arrival. Dogs that have not been in a high-risk country in the previous 6 months are not required by CDC to present a rabies vaccination certificate or other paperwork, but vaccination against rabies is recommended.

These rules apply to all dogs, including puppies, service animals, and service dogs.

These rules also apply whether you are:

[List level 1] - Just visiting the United States with your dog

[List level 1] - Importing dogs into the United States

[List level 1] - Traveling out of the United States and returning with your dog after a temporary visit, such as a vacation or holiday, or for shopping or visiting friends and relatives.

If you do not follow CDC’s rules, your dog may not be allowed to enter the United States.

Kuanzia tarehe 14 Julai hadi 14 Oktoba 2021, mbwa wanaotoka nchi zenye hatari kubwa (kiungo: https://www.cdc.gov/importation/dogs/high-risk-countries.html ) walio na vibali vya CDC vya kuingiza mbwa nchini wanaweza kuingia Marekani kupitia mojawapo ya viwanja hivi 18 vya ndege: Anchorage, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago (ORD), Dallas (DFW), Detroit, Honolulu, Houston (IAH), Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, New York (JFK), Newark, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Juan, Seattle, na Washington, DC (Dulles).

Mbwa wote wanaoingizwa Marekani lazima wawe na afya njema wanapowasili. CDC haihitaji mbwa ambao hawajakuwa katika nchi yenye hatari kubwa kwa miezi 6 months iliyopita kuwasilisha cheti cha chanjo dhidi ya kichaa cha mbwa au nyaraka nyingine, lakini chanjo dhidi ya kichaa cha mbwa inapendekezwa.

Kanuni hizi zinawahusu mbwa wote, wakiwemo watoto wa mbwa, wanyama wa usaidizi na mbwa wa usaidizi.

Kanuni hizi pia zinatumika ikiwa:

[List level 1] - Unatembelea Marekani tu ukiwa na mbwa wako.

[List level 1] - Unaingiza mbwa nchini Marekani.

[List level 1] - Unasafiri kutoka Marekani na kurudi ukiwa na mbwa wako baada ya ziara ya muda mfupi, kama vile likizo, kwenda kufanya ununuzi au kuwatembelea marafiki na jamaa.

Usipofuata kanuni za CDC, mbwa wako huenda asiruhusiwe kuingia Marekani.

parents.english_text:
Need Special Care?

Sit back and relax! Travel should be worry-free. That’s why we are here to help at every step. We accommodate travelers with all kinds of special needs, from kids traveling alone to people traveling with wheelchairs. Whatever your needs might be, we will make your travel comfortable and easy.

Special Care Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/special-care/

Unaccompanied Minor

Traveling alone as a minor can be an exciting adventure, but it's natural to have concerns. At Kenya Airways, we prioritize the safety and comfort of unaccompanied minors. Here's what you need to know to ensure a secure and seamless journey for your young traveler:

Guidelines & Requirements:

[List level 1] - Guidelines and Age Restrictions: Our unaccompanied minor services cater to children aged 5 to 14, with specific guidelines in place to ensure their well-being and assistance. Children aged below 5 years must travel with an adult guardian

[List level 1] - Required Documentation: To facilitate a smooth journey, the Unaccompanied Minor Form must be completed accurately. This form provides essential information about the child, guardians, and designated pickup person. Get the form here(Link:https://www.kenya-airways.com/globalassets/commercial/plan/special-care/unaccompanied-minors/kq_unaccompaniedminor_form.pdf ).

Unaccompanied Minors are accepted only on Kenya Airways-operated flights.

Expert Support & Fees:
parents.kiswahili_search_text:
Je, Unahitaji Huduma Maalumu?

Keti kwa utulivu na upumzike! Safari inapaswa kuwa bila wasiwasi. Ndiyo sababu tuko hapa kukusaidia katika kila hatua. Tunawahudumia wasafiri wenye mahitaji maalumu ya aina mbalimbali, kuanzia watoto wanaosafiri peke yao hadi watu wanaotumia viti vya magurudumu. Bila kujali mahitaji yako, tutahakikisha safari yako ni rahisi na yenye starehe.

Kiungo cha Huduma Maalumu: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/special-care/

Mtoto Anayesafiri Peke Yake

Kusafiri peke yake kunaweza kuwa tukio la kusisimua kwa mtoto, lakini ni kawaida kuwa na wasiwasi. Katika Kenya Airways, tunatanguliza usalama na starehe za watoto wanaosafiri bila kuandamana na mtu mzima. Yafuatayo ndiyo unayohitaji kujua ili kuhakikisha mtoto wako anasafiri kwa usalama na bila matatizo:

Miongozo na Mahitaji:

[List level 1] - Miongozo na Vikomo vya Umri: Huduma zetu kwa watoto wanaosafiri peke yao zinahusu watoto wa umri wa miaka 5 hadi 14, kwa kuzingatia miongozo maalumu inayohakikisha ustawi wao na kuwapatia usaidizi. Watoto walio chini ya miaka 5 years lazima wasafiri pamoja na mlezi mtu mzima.

[List level 1] - Nyaraka Zinazohitajika: Ili kurahisisha safari, Fomu ya Mtoto Anayesafiri Peke Yake lazima ijazwe kwa usahihi. Fomu hii hutoa taarifa muhimu kuhusu mtoto, walezi na mtu aliyeteuliwa kumpokea. Pata fomu hapa (Kiungo: https://www.kenya-airways.com/globalassets/commercial/plan/special-care/unaccompanied-minors/kq_unaccompaniedminor_form.pdf ).

Watoto wanaosafiri peke yao wanakubaliwa tu katika safari za ndege zinazoendeshwa na Kenya Airways.

Usaidizi wa Kitaalamu na Ada:

Expert Support & Fees:

[List level 1] - Expert Assistance: A dedicated team handles the booking process, ensuring all necessary information about the child, parents/guardians, and the designated pick-up person is collected accurately.

[List level 1] - Unaccompanied Minor Fee: While a fee applies for unaccompanied minor services, it covers the personalized care, support, and supervision provided during the trip. The fee is exempted for Domestic travel only, (NBO, MBA, KIS)

[List level 1] - Unaccompanied Minor Groups: If an unaccompanied minor group is not accompanied by an adult, unaccompanied minor fees will apply. If accompanied by an adult, our standard group policy will apply.

NB: We also provide the service to young adults aged 15 to 17 upon request from a parent or guardian.

Tailored Flights, Smooth Transitions, and Efficient Check-In:

[List level 1] - Tailored Flights: Our system helps you choose flights that align with your child's schedule, with a focus on non-stop or minimally connected routes for a smoother journey.

[List level 1] - Transition at International Airports: For passengers with separate documents and onward domestic sectors on other airlines, our unaccompanied minor service concludes at the international airport. This ensures a seamless transition.

[List level 1] - Ada ya Mtoto Anayesafiri Peke Yake: Ingawa huduma hii inatozwa ada, ada hiyo hugharamia utunzaji wa kibinafsi, usaidizi na uangalizi unaotolewa wakati wa safari. Ada hii haitozwi kwa safari za ndani ya nchi pekee (NBO, MBA, KIS).

Infant & Toddlers

At Kenya Airways, we understand that traveling with infants requires special attention and care. Here's how we aim to provide a seamless and comfortable experience for you and your little one:

Travel Comfort for Families with Infants:

[List level 1] - Priority Boarding: Families with infants are usually offered priority boarding, giving you extra time to settle in and prepare for the flight.

[List level 1] - Bulkhead Seating: Our aircraft often have designated bulkhead seats equipped with bassinets. These seats provide extra legroom and space for your baby to rest comfortably

[List level 1] - Bassinet Reservations: To ensure availability, you can request a bassinet when booking your flight or through our customer service. We'll do our best to accommodate your request.

[List level 1] - In-Flight Changing Tables: Our lavatories are equipped with changing tables to make diaper changes more convenient for you.

Except as provided by applicable law, passengers may travel alone on our flights provided they are self supporting on board and can assist in their own evacuation should the need arise.

[List level 1] - Self-supporting means that:

[List level 1] - Passenger can be able to eat unassisted.

[List level 1] - Passenger can administer his/her medication unassisted.

[List level 1] - If necessary, the passenger can visit the lavatory unassisted. Help from the crew is limited to bringing the onboard wheelchair to the passenger and pushing it to and from the lavatory door. Therefore, the passenger shall be required to lift him/herself -using the upper body power - in and out of the onboard wheelchair unassisted.

[List level 1] - If the passenger is not self-supporting, he/she must travel with a companion(i.e., personal care attendant) who is able to perform these functions; except that for flights to and from the U.S., a safety assistant shall not be required to accompany a passenger except as permitted by applicable law.

Passengers with Reduced Mobility Travelling as a Group

1. Groups of 5 or more passengers shall be handled in a manner conforming with the normal group handling procedures, except that advance arrangements shall be made to provide additional ground equipment and assistance staff necessary, consistent with applicable law.

1. Who Requires Medical Clearance to Fly?

If you have a pre-existing medical condition, we advise you visit your doctor before you fly, so that we can know how to best serve you.

You require a medical clearance to fly if you:

[List level 1] - Recently had a major medical incident (heart attack, heart failure, stroke and respiratory failure, recent pneumothorax, etc).

[List level 1] - Had surgery within the previous two weeks

[List level 1] - One has a pre-existing heart or respiratory condition

[List level 1] - Have a medical condition which may be adversely affected by flying

[List level 1] - Have thrombophlebitis or history of pulmonary embolism

[List level 1] - Have unstable mental illness/impairment

[List level 1] - You are unable to care for yourself hence needs special assistance

[List level 1] - If you cannot use a normal upright seat e.g. a stretcher or medical condition that necessitates extra legroom

[List level 1] - Need in-flight oxygen, a portable oxygen concentrator (POC) or ventilator

[List level 1] - Need battery-powered* medical equipment (except for CPAP) or a medical procedure during the flight

If you have any of the above or other medical conditions, download and complete the MEDIF (Medical Information Form for Fitness to Fly) at least 24 hours before travel is due to commence and submit to doctors.kq@kenya-airways.com or our 24-hour Contact Centre Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747 or WhatsApp: +254 705 474 747 for assistance.

[List level 1] - Una ugonjwa au tatizo la afya ya akili ambalo halijatulia.

10. Animals on Board

Kenya Airways offers this service free of charge for passengers who require assistance through trained and certified dogs.

Service dog – a dog, regardless of breed or type, that is individually trained to do work or perform tasks for the benefit of a qualified individual with a disability, including a physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disability, and any other condition required to have (service dog)SVAN.

Animal species other than dogs, emotional support animals, comfort animals, companionship animals, and service animals in training are not service animals.
